target: Experimental summary-v2 L1 and L2-plus hierarchy contracts and projectors
primary_semantics: Keep V2 L1 as the high-recall source layer while making V2 L2 and higher compact, direct-child navigation layers with deterministic durable-state promotion.
invariants: Raw records, summary-v1, and existing L1 sidecars remain byte unchanged.
V2 format version is independent from L1, L2, and higher hierarchy levels.
Every parent routes every direct child summary and every route reaches retained raw message IDs.
Every deterministic promotion-manifest entry survives in parent durable state.
Ordinary child detail remains navigable in the child and is not required to be copied upward.
The feature remains opt-in, external-sidecar only, and disconnected from production maintenance and retrieval.
allowed_changes: Split L1 and parent prompts and response schemas.
Change only the experimental parent source, validation, projection, and Markdown contracts.
Add deterministic promotion selection and semantic deduplication.
Add focused hierarchy tests and contract documentation.
prohibited_changes: Do not rewrite raw history, summary-v1, or prior sidecars.
Do not activate a scheduler, maintenance route, dashboard route, retrieval route, federation route, or cloud route.
Do not treat ordinary child prose repetition as parent completeness.
Do not let model output choose source identity, promotion eligibility, final IDs, or storage paths.
before_after_checks: Run L1, L2, and L3 positive and negative hierarchy tests.
Verify direct-child navigation and raw-message reachability.
Verify missing promoted state fails and ordinary detail need not be promoted.
Verify existing summary-v1 bytes remain unchanged during sidecar persistence.
Run Python compile, architecture contract, documentation contract, and diff check.
